title: Nationwide Awareness Promotion for Appointment of Deputies for Those who have Lost Mental Capacity
what_it_is: Nationwide Awareness Promotion for Appointment of Deputies for Those who have Lost Mental Capacity

sections.label: LPA fee waiver extension
sections.summary: The fee waiver for Singaporeans making an LPA Form 1 with general donee powers is extended to 31 August 2018, with about 23,000 applications in two years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: The fee waiver for Singaporeans making an LPA Form 1 giving the donee general powers has been extended till 31 August 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: In the last two years, about 23,000 LPA applications were received, compared with 7,200 received over the previous four years prior to the fee waiver.

sections.label: MINDS project support and expansion
sections.summary: Parents are assisted by MINDS school psychologists, social workers, volunteer academics and NUS Law students, with plans to extend to more Special Education schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: In this project, parents are assisted by MINDS school psychologists, social workers, volunteer academics and students from the National University of Singapore Law Faculty.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: We hope to extend the project to two more Special Education schools by the end of this year, and three more next year.

sections.label: Pro-bono deputy panel
sections.summary: A panel of professionals was established for the Court to appoint as pro-bono deputies for low-income individuals without willing family or friends, currently with 18 members.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: For low-income individuals who have no family members or friends willing and able to be appointed as their deputies, my Ministry has established a panel of professionals that the Court can appoint as deputies on a pro-bono basis.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: There are currently 18 public-spirited professionals from the financial, healthcare, legal and social work sectors on this panel.

sections.label: Judicial evaluation of deputies
sections.summary: A judicial body should evaluate whether a person lacks capacity and whether a proposed deputy is suitable, and this is not a step currently prepared to be taken.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: At first glance, it would seem like a very reasonable request, but allowing someone to make a decision for an adult is a very serious matter.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: Hence, a judicial body, for Page: 19 example, the Family Justice Courts, should evaluate if the person lacks capacity to make his own decisions and the proposed deputy is suitable to act in the long term, even if it is the next-of-kin, for example, the parents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: I understand where the Member is coming from, but I think it is a very serious step.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: This is something that for the present moment, we do not feel that is a step we are prepared to take.

sections.label: Improving LPA forms
sections.summary: The legal document is important, the forms can be continually improved, and feedback would be conveyed to the Courts to streamline stickers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: But at the same time, it is also important to remember that this is an important legal document.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: We are quite happy to continually improve the forms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: For example, the feedback from the Member, I would be happy to convey to the Courts to see whether they can streamline the stickers and so on.
